svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.2.1 Occupancy Classification
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Occupancy Classification

g.text: Low-hazard industrial occupancies (Does not include storage garages serving
Notes to Table 9.10.2.1.: (1) See Note A-3.1.2.1.(1).

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as provided in Article 9.10.2.2., every
building or part thereof is classified
according to its major occupancy as belonging
to one of the groups or divisions described in
Examples from Note A-3.1.2.1.(1)
Group C: apartments, boarding houses,
dormitories, hotels, houses, lodging houses,
motels. Group D: banks, barber and hairdressing
shops, dental offices, medical offices, offices,
radio stations. Group E: department stores,
exhibition halls, markets, shops, stores,
supermarkets. Group F, Division 2: aircraft
hangars, factories, laboratories, repair garages,
service stations, warehouses, workshops. Group F,
Division 3: creameries, factories, laboratories,
power plants, storage garages including open air
parking garages, storage rooms.
Drawn: one example building for each group or division. Colours mark the classification.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.2.1. (page 9-59)
